TC-018.summary: [FE][BE] Verify trimmed spaces and a case change in a master data value are not edits, and a case change in free text is an edit
TC-018.pre: Works `W-8394-T1` to `W-8394-T6`, each with one breakdown, at `Reviewed` / `Breakdown Reviewed`. Logged in as `Somchai Tester`.

steps.action: Export the Worklist and build an import file with Action `Revise` for `W-8394-T1` to `W-8394-T6` and their breakdowns, all status cells blank, with only the changes of table 13.
steps.data:
Table 13
| Work | Change on the row | Expected Work Status | Expected Breakdown Status |
| W-8394-T1 | Work row: two spaces after the `Job Description` | Reviewed | Breakdown Reviewed |
| W-8394-T2 | Work row: `Work Header` in lower case | Reviewed | Breakdown Reviewed |
| W-8394-T3 | Work row: `Job Description` in upper case | Updated | Breakdown Reviewed |
| W-8394-T4 | Breakdown row: a space before the `Job Description` | Reviewed | Breakdown Reviewed |
| W-8394-T5 | Breakdown row: `Working Location (Deck)` in lower case | Reviewed | Breakdown Reviewed |
| W-8394-T6 | Breakdown row: `Job Description` in lower case | Reviewed | Breakdown Updated |
steps.result: The file is saved with twelve rows.

steps.action: Upload the file as `Somchai Tester`.
steps.result: The preview shows no Error and `Confirm` is enabled.

steps.action: Click `Confirm`.
steps.result: The import completes.

steps.action: Read the Work Status of `W-8394-T1` to `W-8394-T6`.
steps.result: Each shows the expected Work Status of table 13.

steps.action: Read the Breakdown Status of `W-8394-T1` to `W-8394-T6`.
steps.result: Each shows the expected Breakdown Status of table 13.
